messages:
Maya: Heads up — Sales (Priya) escalated a private deployment request from GreenLeafRetail. They want VPC-hosted/private inference in eu-west-1, HSM-backed KMS, and the option for on-prem air-gapped install. Sales asked for a feasibility + timeline by EOD Friday.
Sam: Added ticket #4567 to intake: https://redwood.atlassian/ISSUE-4567. Quick summary: 200 RPS inference, single-model Llama2-finetuned, latency SLO 150ms p50, data residency EU. Priya says compliance is strict.
Jordan: Key dependencies: (1) KMS/HSM integration (customer-managed key) (2) Network egress rules + private endpoints (3) Monitoring forwarding to customer's SIEM (4) Operator access model (SAML/Okta).
Tess: Rough rough estimate: 6–8 weeks for VPC-only if no custom infra; add 4–6 weeks for on-prem (air-gap) due to packaging, validation, and legal. Need infra team input.
Maya: Launch acceptance criteria proposal: - KMS integration tested (with customer) - Model serving at target latency under load test - Audit logs flowing to customer SIEM - Formal runbook and rollback steps - Security review signed off
Sam: From support: they need backup/restore docs and sample terraform snippets. I'll draft a checklist. Also confirm whether we can reuse Nebula-bank's deployment template or if GreenLeaf requires different subnets.
Jordan: Flags: HSM access may require on-site hardware or cloud HSM with cross-account access — runs into procurement lead times. Also quantization/weights size may affect memory footprint; need model profile.
Priya (sales): They're okay signing an MSA for a 12-mo commitment, but timeline is critical. If Private is delayed, they want a Dedicated-reserved fallback for 3 months.
Tess: Action items: 1) Sam: collect model artifacts + seq length distribution by Wed 2) Infra: confirm template reuse and estimate (Sam tag @eng-infra) 3) Security: outline KMS/HSM requirements and STIGs 4) Ops: draft runbook and acceptance tests
Jordan: I'll slot a 30-min review Fri 10am with infra/security/ops — invite sent.
intake-bot: Ticket #4567 assigned to product-intake. SLA: 72h initial assessment.
Maya: Cool — let's keep this concise. Priority: P1 for product intake. We'll update JIRA with the agreed timeline after Friday's review. :thumbsup:
